plugins.name: crumora
plugins.description: Eight skills that redo your work as a tournament: rewrite rebuilds it from scratch, sharpen improves it in place with reviewable diffs, reskin redesigns and re-lays-out the interface, tribunal puts the code on trial before a panel of lenses that argue with each other, checklist gates it against fifteen fixed rules with PASS or FAIL, report measures the data and writes the result up as a self-contained HTML report, specify turns a raw need text into atomic testable requirements, and diagram draws how it works without letting the picture turn into a wall. Every attempt is scored against a frozen rubric, fought head-to-head against the reigning champion, and reported with a round-by-round table.
